rendered: In Table Table 1[1], the row for the low-cobalt, nickel-rich section (Section 6[2], Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes) names NMC 811[3] cathodes. In the ORNL study the paper describes, these cathodes kept 80%[4] of their capacity at the high charging rate. The corresponding NMC 532[5] cathodes kept only 49%[6] and the NMC 622[7] cathodes kept only 56%[8] of their capacity, respectively, at the same rate.
